evidence: Wikipedia's article on Johnny Marr: he described liking records, even spacious ones, that sound symphonic, with all the players merged into one atmosphere, an idea influenced by Phil Spector.

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Spector stacked many players in one room so that guitars, pianos and drums blur into a single roar. 'How Soon Is Now?' gets there with a few players and many overdubs: layers of tremolo guitar that merge into one throbbing sound. Listen for how hard it is to pick out a single guitar.

explanation.age13: Johnny Marr liked records where all the instruments blend into one big sound, an idea he took from the producer Phil Spector, who did it in the early 1960s.
explanation.adult: Production in the sense of an idea about how a record should sound, not of a credit: Spector never worked with the Smiths. On the map, Spector's conduct and conviction are on his own record.
